question: 5 boys J, K, L, M and N are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). N is second to the left of J. K is second to the left of N. Only one boy is to the left of L. How many boys are sitting to the right of N?
solution:
Given: Five boys J, K, L, M and N are sitting in a row facing north.

N is second to the left of J.

K is second to the left of N

Only one boy is to the left of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4db2323890c0220af2cbef6be6b06b8ccfa2541840c505c66ee0612191217b85.png] 

So, count = 2

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
